name: tech-tools
description: The atlas marketplace: a multi-agent coding architect (atlas) with 39 plainly named skills, 14 core agents, self-improvement hooks, and the atlas-orchestrate methodology (evidence before any done claim), plus an optional organizational deployment plugin (armada) with 4 invocable setup skills, 11 department agents, and 156 department skills, and a book-derived principles checker (programmer) with 20 detected rules, 2 skills and 1 judge agent.

plugins.name: atlas
plugins.description: Multi-agent coding architect for Claude Code: plans, delegates to named subagents, verifies with evidence, and blocks 'done' until the evidence exists.

plugins.name: armada
plugins.description: Organizational deployment layer split out of atlas. Four invocable setup skills in run order: armada (deployment status and router), armada-brand (org name, voice, colors, commit style - run first), armada-department (activate one of 11 departments and its agent), armada-connect (the 13 vendor MCP connectors armada ships). Behind them: 11 department agents (data, design, engineering, finance, HR, IT ops, M365, product, productivity, security, support) and 156 department skills carrying org branding, policies, and compliance context. Enterprise mode (armada-enterprise): deploy the MCP gateway for an organization in Azure, map Entra groups to connector roles, review audit logs, connect Claude. Install alongside atlas only for org use.

plugins.name: programmer
plugins.description: Finds code that breaks book-derived principles. A deterministic Python scanner with 20 detected rules (DRY, small functions, crash early, Law of Demeter, shared state, injection, dependency rule, inheritance tax, CQS and more), each tied to a book and tip and proven by fixtures; JSON and SARIF output for CI. A cited model judge covers what code cannot decide. 2 skills (review, principles) and 1 agent (principles-judge).
